about: The oldest ChartBridge each page version works with. nt8/update-pc.ps1 installs a page automatically only when the ChartBridge compiled on the PC is this version or newer. Keep it with the CHANGELOG: every release that needs a newer ChartBridge raises minChartBridge (and adds a line to history), and page follows package.json.

history.note: CHANGELOG chart 1.39.0: house style V2, black and gold, on the chart page and the Markup Studio (Anthony 2026-10-24: "lets unify everything"): gold replaces the purple accent and the crimson, the chart's own colors (ground, grid, axes, crosshair, tags) in V2's black and warm greys with every contrast floor kept, the candles and indicators unchanged, a Black and gold candle preset in Colors, pills, the tab ink, the gold hairlines, the V2 motion where no live value or order is (reduced motion: none); page only, ChartBridge stays 0.6.8 (minChartBridge stays 0.6.2)

CHANGELOG ChartBridge 0.6.8 and chart 1.38.1: the history gap after a reload (ChartBridge 0.6.8 keeps 1-minute bars from every live trade and fills minute and tick charts up to now with them; 20 s limits on a load's minute history and last trades; a hole it cannot fill is recorded in /diag and history.log, not shown), the page says a LOADING that waits on NinjaTrader, the League chart and the Agents panel's Drone sky on NQ 1 min (Anthony 2026-10-23); the page works with ChartBridge 0.6.2 (minChartBridge stays 0.6.2); ChartBridge 0.6.8 is a recompile

CHANGELOG chart 1.38.0: the Agents panel becomes the Drone sky (the agents active today as drones over MNQ's minute bars, their looks, passes, trades and Anthony's entries from what the page already reads; hover for the card, click for the tab; read only); order labels at the same price stack in the gutter by the price axis, never over the candles (the dragged one pinned at its line); the Multi-Account lane headers wrap, never overlap; page only, ChartBridge stays 0.6.7
